pages.title: About
pages.content:
About

Neiro Music is a private music school at Lindenhof 14, Ghent, in a converted print works. Pianist Ilse Marchetti opened it in 2011. Two floors hold six teaching rooms and, since 2016, the 60-seat Long Room for recitals.

Eight teachers work with 240 pupils across a thirty-week year, September to June. Children start piano or violin from age five, and adults begin at any age.

Meet the teachers

pages.title: Lessons
pages.content:
Instruments

Piano, violin, cello, voice and guitar, taught one to one. A weekly lesson lasts 30, 45 or 60 minutes. Children's piano and strings: 30 minutes weekly is €290 per term of ten lessons, 45 minutes is €420.

Adult beginners take the 45-minute lesson at €450 per term. The first meeting, a 30-minute trial lesson with a teacher, is free.

Fees and enrolment

pages.title: A Week at Neiro
pages.content:
A teaching day

Lessons run Monday to Friday from 14:00 to 21:30 and on Saturday from 09:00 to 18:00. Sunday is closed. At 15:30 the youngest pupils arrive, strings follow at 16:45, the ear and theory table meets at 18:00 and adult beginners at 19:15.

The Friday evening ensemble meets at 20:30, directed by Marco Bellini. On Monday to Thursday the last lessons end at 21:30.

pages.title: Teachers
pages.content:
Teachers

Ilse Marchetti (founder, piano), Tomás Rivera (guitar), Amara Okonkwo (voice), Léa Fournier (violin), Jonas Weber (cello), Priya Raman (piano, adult beginners), Hannah Lindgren (ear and theory) and Marco Bellini (ensemble director).

Sofie De Smet runs the office and answers the phone Monday to Friday, 13:00–18:00.

pages.title: Fees
pages.content:
Fees

Trial lesson, 30 min: €0. Children's piano or strings, 30 min weekly, per term (10 lessons): €290. 45 min weekly, per term: €420. Adult beginners, 45 min weekly, per term: €450. Ear and theory group (max 6), per term: €140. Friday evening ensemble, per term: €120.

Registration is €35 once per year. A sibling discount of 10% is applied to lesson fees. To enrol: book a free trial, meet a teacher for 30 minutes, choose an instrument and a weekly slot, then start the term.

Book a free trial lesson

pages.title: Recitals
pages.content:
Recitals

Pupils play in the Long Room twice in the teaching year, in December and in June. The room seats sixty and has a grand piano on a low stage under warm lamps.

The Friday evening ensemble joins the programme when the term reaches its recital.

pages.title: Stories
pages.content:
Pupils' stories

Noor, 7, started violin and played in the December recital after one term. Pieter, 58, began piano as an adult and now plays duets with his granddaughter. The Haddad sisters, 10 and 13, play piano and cello together in the Friday ensemble.

pages.title: FAQ
pages.content:
FAQ

How old must a child be? Piano and violin start at five. Is there an age limit for adults? No. Can we try a lesson first? Yes, a 30-minute trial lesson is free. How long is the year? Thirty teaching weeks, September to June.

pages.title: Visit
pages.content:
Visit

Neiro Music, Lindenhof 14, 9000 Ghent, Belgium. Lessons Monday to Friday 14:00–21:30, Saturday 09:00–18:00, Sunday closed. Office and phone Monday to Friday 13:00–18:00: +32 9 555 01 14, hello@neiromusic.example.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.content:
Privacy

This is a sample site for a fictional school. It collects no personal data beyond what you send when you write to the office, and uses that only to answer you.

posts.excerpt: The thirty teaching weeks run from September to June, with recitals in December and June.
posts.content:
The 2026–27 year runs for thirty teaching weeks, September to June. Lessons are held Monday to Friday 14:00–21:30 and Saturday 09:00–18:00.

Registration is €35 once per year. Term fees are listed on the Fees page.

posts.title: The June recital in the Long Room
posts.excerpt: Pupils played in the Long Room, with the Friday ensemble.
posts.content: The June recital filled the Long Room's sixty chairs. Pupils of every age played short pieces, and the Friday evening ensemble closed the programme.

posts.title: Jonas Weber joins as cello teacher
posts.excerpt: Jonas Weber teaches cello one to one.
posts.content: Jonas Weber teaches cello to children and adult beginners. His pupils join the Friday evening ensemble when they are ready to play with others.
